rows.en: This is bad... We can't even scratch it...
This is bad! At this rate...
Crap, this is seriously bad! What the hell do we do!!
What do we do... What do we do...
This is bad...
What now... With this much damage...
I-Is this the end...?
Ace Killer!! The heroes are weakening!!
Now! Finish them off!!
At that moment, the heroes heard the voices of Ultraman and Ace!
Don't give up. I will share my life with you.
Brother...
Ace, you've been badly drained.
No, I want to help them too.
Very well. Then, here we go...
Light full of energy poured down onto the heroes from the two Ultras' Color Timers!!
Wh-What!? What is happening!!
Ohh... I can feel the power surging!! Ultraman! Ace! Thanks a lot!!
Brothers...!! The power... the power is surging through me!!
Power... power is surging within me...!!
Somehow, I feel my strength coming back!!
I can feel power surging through me!!
It's like all that damage never happened... With this, we can win!!
Power's surging through me!!
Ooohh!! The power's comin' back!! Time to hit my climax all over again!!
What is this power...!? I can still fight...!!
What is this power flowing through my body!!
I feel it... I feel the power...
My strength is... surging back...?
Blast it!! Ace Killer!! What are you hesitating for!
Your enemy is right in front of you!! Hurry up and finish them!!
Obtained the "Execution Ground Key (Left)".
...Curse you! But know that this is far from over!
Ace Killer will rise again, as many times as it takes!! Remember that!!!
{8074} and the others rescued Ultraman and Ultraman Ace.
Brother!! Brother Ace!! Are you all right!!
...Forgive me. Such a blunder is unworthy of an Ultra Warrior...
That's not true! We only won thanks to you, Brothers!!
Never mind that. Now is the time for us to join forces and fight.
Right!
...More importantly, it's Ace. He took more damage than I did.
...Don't worry about me.
...Brother Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition! Let's go to the base!!
A base? Can he be treated there!? Good. I'll take on the job of carrying Ace.
Ultraman carried the gravely wounded Ace to the base.
Ultraman joined the party!
HP fully restored.
Ultraman!! Ultraman Ace!! You two okay!?
Brother Ultraman, Ace, are you all right!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are you both all right!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are you both all right!?
You two okaaay!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are you both all right!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are you all right!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are you both all right!?
Ultraman! Ace! Are the two of you all right!?
Are you two all right!?
Are you two all right!?
Forgive me... I let my guard down, of all things.
But fortunately, my damage is light. I should be able to fight right away.
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
I see. That's good.
Glad to hear it.
Hey, that's great!
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
That's a relief...
But Ace is...
No, I can fight too... A wound like this is nothing...
Ace!! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's head to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's head to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's head to the base!!
...Ace! It's too dangerous in your condition. Let's head to the base!!
...Ace! You're in bad shape. We're goin' to the base!!

notes.note: #0.40-0.51 are 12 leader variants; order from 0356.bla's Pt_Chara_Check run before them (char ids 15,14,12,5,1,4,2,3,6,7,10,9): Zero, Mebius, Seven, OOO, Rider 1, W, Black RX, Den-O Sword, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. Voices match (Ankh named in OOO's #0.43, rough #0.47 = Momotaros). So #0.45 = W (Shotaro) ... #0.51 = Wing Zero. 'Ha ga tatanee' = 'can't even scratch it' (Ace Killer, g=n).
Wing Zero (Heero) faltering 'Is this the end' follows the script order; unusual for Heero but kept.
'Ultraman-tachi' = Ultraman and Ace (both crucified, both speak next); hearers restored as 'the heroes'.
'Inochi wo wake ataeyou' = share my life with you: the classic Ultra life-energy transfer.
'Color Timer' is the established English name of the Ultras' chest lamp; not in glossary.

#0.65-0.76 are 12 leader variants in the same order as #0.40-0.51: Zero, Mebius ('Brothers'), Seven, OOO, Rider 1, W, RX, Den-O ('climax'), Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. Trailing line break in #0.65 dropped.
Momotaros 'mou ichido, climax da ze' echoes his fixed 'at my climax' line.
Zeta: echo of Kamille's famous 'What is this power flowing through my body?'; source punctuation '!!' kept.
Trailing full-width space in source dropped.
Item name not yet translated anywhere; rendered 'Execution Ground Key (Left)'. The right one appears in 0357 #0.71 and should be '(Right)'.
Ace Killer referred to as 'it' (glossary g=n).

#0.88-0.96 are the Mebius-leader branch (the Pt_Chara_Check run before it lists id 14 first; 'niisan / Ace-niisan' fits Mebius). The '00' speaker label on #0.88/#0.90/#0.92/#0.95 is a mislabel (last variant name loaded in the decompile); lines voiced as Mebius.
'Ii no da' answers Mebius's protest -> 'Never mind that'.
Subject of 'chiryou ga dekiru' restored as Ace ('he').

#0.105-0.115, #0.118-0.128 and #0.131+ are 11-variant non-Mebius branches; order from the run (ids 14,15,12,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10) minus Mebius: Zero, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Checks: Seven's 'Man-niisan' (#0.106), Den-O's drawl (#0.109, #0.122, #0.135), OOO polite (#0.111). Identical Japanese kept identical.
Seven's 'Man-niisan' -> 'Brother Ultraman' (pattern 'Brother Hikari' from earlier slices).
All bare 'yokatta...' variants rendered identically 'That's a relief...'; #0.120 Rider 1, #0.121 RX, #0.122 Den-O have distinct wording.
#0.131-0.135 = Zero, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O; the block continues into story_062. Direction: speaker urging Ace to the base.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant orders taken from 0356.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs and confirmed by voice. #0.88-0.95 '00' label is a mislabel: Mebius-leader branch. Not in glossary: Color Timer; item 'Execution Ground Key (Left)'.
